messages:
incident-bot: Pager P0 — elevated 5xx rate detected at transport layer (502/504). Region: eu-west-1. Spike start ~2026-03-17T02:03:19Z. Current 5xx ~17% (baseline ~0.6%). Paging @priya-oncall & @alex-sre.
priya-oncall: looking at console now. Errors concentrated on ingress proxy pool-7 (hostnames: ip-10-2-7-*) and high tcp_retrans.
alex-sre: confirming logs show repeated upstream conn resets + backend 504s. sample log snippet: `upstream: remote_closed_conn, target=10.3.14.22:443`
mike-ops: can we reroute traffic to eu-central as a short-term relief? how fast can LB weights change?
priya-oncall: yes — plan: 1) enable fastfail on mux for non-critical routes 2) circuit-break heavy mobile clients 3) shift 30% traffic eu-west -> eu-central 4) restart 2 proxy instances in pool-7. rolling now.
alex-sre: applying circuit-breaker for client_group=mobile-v1 -> `./opsctl circuit-break --group mobile-v1 --enable`
```
# running on control plane
opsctl route update --region eu-west --weight-adjust -30
opsctl lb shift --from eu-west --to eu-central --pct 30
```
tess-support: FYI CS: ticket queue shows multiple reports from @big-retailer and @clearcart about checkout failures (~300 failures last 5m). I'm flagging customer-impact.
jordan-plateng: on it — drafting customer note: "We are investigating increased 502/504 errors affecting EU customers. Mitigations in progress; no data loss reported. ETA 15-30m for stabilization." Will post to status page after Priya OKs.
alex-sre: restarting proxy instances 2/7 -> `systemctl restart ingress-proxy` on ip-10-2-7-12 and ip-10-2-7-15. tailing logs.
mike-ops: LB shift in progress, new weights applied. Observability shows request fanout decreasing on eu-west proxies.
incident-bot: automated response: autoscaler triggered +4 ingress-proxy instances for pool-7.
priya-oncall: metrics update: 5xx dropped from 17% -> 6% in last 3m, median latency returned to baseline. Keep mitigation for 10m, then gradual rollback of circuit-break and traffic shift.
alex-sre: will capture kcore and tcp stack info for postmortem, saving /var/log/proxy/conn-trace-1738809999.log -> s3://redwood-ops/incident-1738809999/
tess-support: posted interim status to customers-eu and escalated big-retailer contact.
jordan-plateng: status page updated. will coordinate follow-up comms and timeline.
priya-oncall: good job team. assigning postmortem to alex-sre + mike-ops. We kept data integrity; likely root cause: connection pool exhaustion + upstream slow responses during a short burst. Will run detailed root-cause analysis and share runbook improvements.
alex-sre: noted. I'll also add a shortplay: add healthchecks + earlier fastfail threshold to prevent pool pileup.
mike-ops: monitoring -> alerts set to watch tcp_retrans and pool-utilization.
priya-oncall: closing channel for live mitigation. we will reopen if 5xx >5% again. thanks. :thumbsup:
